description: Windah first time fishing in GTA VI and his first catch. Source: Windah Basudara own launch stream 45r3OyaxvFE (18 Nov 2026), recording G:/My Drive/GTA6/rec1942-h00.mp4 (starts 19:42 WIB); local source.mp4 = that file t=0-420 s (also the 4320-4740 s part of the stream overlap, not needed). Source t (also WIB 19:42:00 + t): A 72.4-75.15 cast ('jauh banget itu'), B 87.45-91.6 ('nunggu 13 tahun buat game ini, bisa mancing'), C 149.82-187.85 bite 'dapet gue', struggle, 'orang pertama di Indonesia yang dapet ikan', fish caught, 'gua pecinta hewan, gua lepasin lagi'. Output t: A 0-2.75, B 2.75-6.9, C 6.9-44.93, outro 44.93-48.93. Layout (shared with windah-gtavi-open, restyled 18 Nov 2026): gameplay top (crop x60 of 1440x1080 -> 1080x810), facecam cutout (crop 400x400 at 1520,640 of the 1920x1080 source, scaled to 600x600) on a blurred copy in a panel y810-1410, blurred background below; hook (3 lines, Volt) at y~520, word-by-word captions (Volt, current word Paper, Audex 88 px, Ink outline 10) centred on the seam at y 830. Original audio kept unmuted (user decision: swears are listed in the report, not muted). Outro appended last; MotionKlip GTA VI watermark over the main part only.
